items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: So when Lou Leslie came back to New York after opening up in Philadelphia he looked for Buck and Bubbles.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was it. I was just trying to think of Erskine Miller, he was a prize fighter. So when Lou Leslie came back to New York after opening up in Philadelphia he looked for Buck and Bubbles. We were at the Paramount and he called the theater to talk to me and I told him he had to talk to my manager who was Nazarro. So what happened is that when we were playing the Paramount Theater we got a call -- we were booked up for two weeks -- we got a call from Billy Rose's office that he wanted to know if we would be…

But he doesn't know the idea of Billy Rose was fool enough to call in for us. So the day goes down. So the next day I figure, why this guy ain't told me nothing about Billy Rose calling. Wonder what his story is. So I called the office to ask him if there was any mail -- no mail. Anybody call for us? No. By that time Nazarro is on the other phone -- he heard me say "nobody called" "No." Then he got on the phone to answer. So I said, "Did you get a call from Billy Rose?" Now they don't know I know that Billy Rose…
